method_note: The audit's deliverables are themselves tracked artifacts and are classified on the same terms as everything else. None of them is loaded by code; none is represented as executable configuration; all exist to be read by people and by whoever writes the follow-up issues. That makes them HUMAN DOCUMENTATION, and saying so here is what keeps this inventory's coverage claim literally complete.
